criteria.statement: domain.Worker exposes WorkerSchedulingState values active, cordoned, draining, maintenance, and disabled separately from WorkerStatus liveness values.
domain.Worker includes SchedulingState, SchedulingNote, and Labels fields.
domain.Worker exposes generic WorkerCapabilities without removing MLCapabilities.
Database migration adds scheduling_state, scheduling_note, labels, and capabilities columns to workers with JSONB support for labels/capabilities.
PgWorkerRepository persists and hydrates scheduling state, scheduling note, labels, and generic capabilities in insert, update, list, and get paths.
Worker label selection is backed by PostgreSQL JSONB containment rather than local filtering.
